title: MAINT — CLI quota meter + the cheap-reads hint
desc:
DELIVERABLE: bin/chatcode counts its own API calls per run (the Api class increments a counter; at exit print one dim line "api: N request(s)" when N ≥ 20; JSON mode keeps stdout clean for parseable commands) — plus a warning when a READ-heavy command would be free from a clone: "hint: --repo-dir <clone> reads cost 0 API calls (the crew shares 5,000/h)".
EVIDENCE: running `tasks list` in API mode prints the count; the same command with --repo-dir prints nothing extra; tests/test_api_meter.py pins both; suite green.
WHY: on 2026-10-14 the shared token hit 5,000/5,000 while three agents worked; each unfiltered `tasks list` in API mode costs one call per task file (~196). The meter makes the cost visible before it bites.
OWNS: bin/chatcode, tests/test_api_meter.py
BRANCH: agent/<you>/<task-id>
